title: How to Cancel FuboTV & Avoid Free Trial Auto-Renewal Charges
metaDescription: Stop FuboTV auto-renewal instantly. Step-by-step guide to cancel Fubo free trial, avoid hidden charges, and request a subscription refund.
intro: FuboTV subscriptions automatically renew at the end of your billing cycle or free trial. Canceling your FuboTV free trial will terminate the service immediately, so time it carefully to avoid a sudden charge of $79.99 or more.

steps.title: Sign in to Fubo.tv
steps.text: Go to fubo.tv on a web browser or mobile browser. Sign in using your registered email and password. Note: You cannot cancel FuboTV through most TV apps directly.

steps.title: Navigate to My Account
steps.text: Hover or tap on your profile icon in the top right corner and select "My Account" from the dropdown menu.
steps.tip: Make sure you are logged into the primary profile of your subscription.

steps.title: Go to Subscription and Billing
steps.text: Locate the "Subscription & Billing" section. Here, you will see your current plan, renewal date, and next billing amount.

steps.title: Click Cancel Subscription
steps.text: Scroll down and click the "Cancel Subscription" button. Fubo will show several retention screens or discount offers.
steps.tip: Do not select 'Pause Subscription' if you want to completely stop billing. Choose 'Complete Cancellation' or 'Cancel Subscription' again.

steps.title: Confirm and check email
steps.text: Provide a reason for canceling if prompted, then click "Cancel Subscription" to confirm. Check your email for a confirmation receipt containing your cancellation reference.
steps.tip: If you are on a free trial, canceling will immediately cut off your streaming access.

warnings: FuboTV free trials terminate IMMEDIATELY upon cancellation. If you cancel on Day 1 of a 7-day trial, you lose access instantly.
FuboTV does not offer prorated refunds for mid-cycle cancellations of paid plans.
If you subscribed through a third party like Apple, Roku, or Amazon, you must cancel through their respective subscription platforms.
Be careful of 'Pause' offers, which will resume billing automatically after a set period.

faqs.q: Will I get a refund if I cancel FuboTV after being charged?
faqs.a: FuboTV has a strict no-refund policy for paid subscriptions once charged. However, if you were accidentally billed due to a trial transition or system error, you can submit a billing dispute.

faqs.q: Can I cancel FuboTV on Apple TV or Roku?
faqs.a: Yes, if you billed through Apple or Roku, go to your Apple ID Subscriptions or Roku Account Portal to cancel. Fubo cannot process cancellations or refunds for third-party billing.

faqs.q: What happens if I pause my Fubo subscription?
faqs.a: Pausing suspends billing for up to 3 months, keeping your profile and DVR settings. After the pause period ends, your credit card will be billed automatically at the standard rate.

refund.details: FuboTV states all fees are non-refundable. However, in cases of unauthorized charges or immediate trial expiration issues, support may grant exceptions if disputed promptly.

retentionTactics: Offering a temporary discount ($10-$20 off your next month).
Encouraging you to 'Pause' your subscription instead of canceling completely.
Warning you about losing scheduled DVR recordings.
